thag1.51:1.1: vassati devo yathā sugītaṃ channā me kuṭikā sukhā nivātā cittaṃ susamāhitaṃ ca mayhaṃ atha ce patthayasi pavassa devā’ti. itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā godhiko thero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā’ti. godhikattheragāthā. 1. 6. 2. vassati devo yathā sugītaṃ
thag1.51:1.5: itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā subāhutthero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā’ti.
